updates.title: Phase 0 foundation initiated
updates.summary: Repository, governance, book architecture, research systems, and dual Astro applications established.

updates.title: Phase 1 Declaration
updates.summary: First draft of the Declaration of Constitutional Capitalism published as the project's philosophical spine, with principles, objections, terminology, system comparison, and strengthened chapter outlines. Not a final ratified doctrine.

updates.title: Transition, testing, and ownership-middle-class architecture captured
updates.summary: Added argument-layer discipline, transition scenarios, national impact assessment agendas, prediction ledger, and a proposed Institute component. Predictions are labeled as predictions — not evidence.

updates.title: Measurability architecture: three books, baseline, CC Test
updates.summary: Captured three-book architecture (public book, Evidence Companion, Implementation Manual), National Baseline dashboard slots, chapter evaluation template, and the ten-question Constitutional Capitalism Test. Phase 2 reframed as evidence + baseline — structure only; no fabricated sources or baseline values.

updates.title: Civilizational core and living-project architecture
updates.summary: Captured power-distribution organizing principle, sacred sentence, subsidiarity acknowledgement, five pillars including Stewardship, living website IA (domains + life paths), corporation-as-partner framing, community economic sovereignty, and duty of constructive improvement. Canonical definition unchanged. Design agendas (permanent ownership/tax shift) remain open — not locked policy.

updates.title: Phase 1 accepted; Phase 2 diagnosis begun
updates.summary: Phase 1 closed (Declaration and foundational philosophy). Phase 2 opens the National Diagnosis, National Baseline, and Evidence Companion — evidence-building, not mass policy writing. Civic deliberation remains a parallel approved track.

updates.title: Phase 2 diagnosis foundation (partial)
updates.summary: Registered primary federal sources (Fed SCF/DFA, BLS, Census, USDA ERS, FDIC, CBO), upgraded 20 priority claims with supporting and contrary evidence, seeded Evidence Companion dossiers, wrote priority national-diagnosis briefs, sourced 2 baseline wealth metrics, and published /where-we-are, /evidence, and /metrics. Remaining domains queued for Phase 2.1. No invented statistics; modeling and legal review remain 0%.

updates.title: Justice, Safety, and Restoration as principal doctrine
updates.summary: Justice is now developing doctrine and a full Phase 2 research domain — the mechanism that makes liberty, ownership, opportunity, and accountability real. Architecture includes five stages, Justice Test, website domain with branches, and pending baseline indicator slots. Detailed justice policy remains blocked until sourced diagnosis. No invented statistics.

updates.title: Democracy as second constitutional spine
updates.summary: Democracy, Representation, and Distributed Government is now a second constitutional spine: trust and anti-entrenchment doctrines, party-as-association principle, Democracy Test, Bill Transparency Test, website domain with branches, and initial sources including Rucho v. Common Cause and NCSL institutional overviews. Detailed election and redistricting policy remains blocked until fuller Phase 2.1 diagnosis.

updates.title: Public service and institutional modernization doctrine
updates.summary: Public Service and the 21st-Century State is now developing doctrine and a full Phase 2 research domain: noble public service, automate-the-routine / elevate-the-human, visible boards, sunset/renewal, open appointments, citizen-centered services, Government Capacity Test, and Arkansas design agendas for a Public Authority Inventory and Civic Service Credential. No invented board counts; detailed administrative policy blocked until sourced diagnosis.

updates.title: Defining idea: invisible government, never unaccountable
updates.summary: Elevated public-service doctrine beyond more/less government. Defining question: better outcomes with fewer layers, less friction, greater accountability. New developing doctrine CC-DEV-025–028 covers friction reduction, the iconic phrase “Government should become invisible—but never unaccountable,” collect-once platform design, and AI that assists but never finally decides legal rights or significant benefits. Regulation Reason Test, citizen-experience metrics, and lean-government formula added. No invented 80/20 statistics or board counts.

updates.title: Constitutional Transparency and the People's Ledger
updates.summary: Fourth institutional spine: public information held in trust; presumed open unless constitutionally or legally justified protections apply; government generally bears the withholding burden. Named instrument: the People's Ledger. Includes agency dashboards, traceable statutes, open procurement and budgets, equal public-access terminals, careful identity rules for routine vs sensitive access, AI as records interpreter, and the Constitutional Transparency Test. Design agenda only — no invented FOIA or portal statistics.

updates.title: Essential Systems: design over predetermined conclusions
updates.summary: Major website and doctrine domain for banking, insurance, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, community health, and prevention. Shared constitutional question; four-question chapter method; Essential Systems Test; productive-value finance principle; health-as-strength and preventive-society goals; Community Health Index design agenda. Framed as incentive redesign — not inherent corruption. No invented sector statistics.

updates.title: Human Capital Doctrine and regional academy pilots
updates.summary: New pillar: deliberately build human capital infrastructure. First principle — every child deserves a meaningful pathway to productive adulthood through multiple respected pathways of equal dignity. Arkansas regional civic/innovation academies are a researchable pilot model (name undecided) organized by regional strengths, with paid apprenticeships, entrepreneurship, civic leadership, and flourishing metrics. Not a locked statewide design; no invented outcomes.

updates.title: Playbooks and the Community Operating System
updates.summary: Practical signature of the movement: adaptive community playbooks and a seven-layer living architecture. Build Your Community surface covers asset inventories, 25-year prosperity stages, Local Prosperity Engine (attract–keep–own), incubator-town patterns, and a permanent Implementation Completeness Rule. Community OS is a design agenda — not an operating product; no invented town growth outcomes.

updates.title: Community Safety, Justice, and Restoration
updates.summary: Justice elevated into a complete Community Safety and Restoration System: Community Safety Corps, relationship policing without arrest quotas, public corrections with no private financial interest in confinement, decision pathways A–E, secure restoration campuses, reentry from day one, Restoration Councils, and automatic transparency. Not merely softer or tougher on crime — more safety, more restoration, less discarded potential. Federal private-prison timeline recorded accurately (2016 Yates; 2017 Sessions rescission). No invented crime or recidivism statistics.

updates.title: Permanent Public Safety System — dignity under continuing custody
updates.summary: Rejects any category of citizens unworthy of reentry. For continuing extreme danger after due process and repeated review: publicly operated Secure Public Safety Campuses — humane permanent incapacitation with continuing review, graduated custody, productive contribution without private enrichment, resource concentration, rejection of exile, and anti-misuse safeguards. Risk scores alone never suffice. No invented custody statistics.

updates.title: Resource Sovereignty and Community Stewardship
updates.summary: Central doctrine: natural resources belong first to the place that bears extraction, consumption, congestion, pollution, and long-term risk. Community Resource Compacts, progressive essential-to-transformative pricing, Community Resource Dividend and Future Generations Fund, community equity, mining/data-center/warehouse rules, Resource and Pollution Ledger, Local Carbon Restoration Exchange with anti-fraud hierarchy, community-owned energy, and household energy floor. Compacts/Ledger/Exchange are design agendas; illustrative revenue splits require modeling; no invented resource statistics.

updates.title: Community Food Security System
updates.summary: Broadens food architecture from a single network idea into a Community Food Security System. Food is critical infrastructure. Principle: meaningful local essential-food capacity while remaining connected to broader markets. Explicitly rejects export-only rules for mass-produced staples. Includes Regional Food Networks, State Food Exchange logistics platform, local value-added production, waste reduction, emergency reserves, regenerative links, food education, and a Community Food Dashboard. Design agendas only; no invented food statistics.

updates.title: Phase 2 mission lock for Burt
updates.summary: Locks Phase 2 as the active proof mission: diagnosis restored; Evidence/Baseline absorbed as aliases; mandatory three-layer diagnosis briefs (data / inference / normative conclusion); acceptance criteria that reject scaffolding-as-completion; developing-doctrine capture clusters for post–Phase 1 ideas; system_interdependencies map. Phase 2 status remains PARTIAL. Civic deliberation stays approved parallel / not active. Modeling and legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Equal Standing Before the Constitution
updates.summary: Foundational principle: every person stands equal before the Constitution — equal protection and equal accountability, without engineered equality of outcome. Adds Blind Stage Principle (conduct before identity), Equality of Opportunity and Accountability, rejection of privilege in every direction, equal-access requirements, shared civic identity, and a seven-question Equal Standing Test. Distinguishes legitimate legal differences (age, conviction after due process) from status privilege. Iconic guide: The Constitution should hear the evidence before it sees the person. Architecture only; no invented access-to-justice statistics.

updates.title: Constitutional Citizenship Doctrine
updates.summary: Core doctrine: self-government requires education. Shifts the question from voting age alone to graduating every citizen prepared for responsible self-government. Democracy is a skill learned through experience — participatory civics, developmental pathway, Youth Leadership Councils (adults remain legally responsible), Civic Graduation portfolios, schools as community laboratories, civic service as contribution, and experience scorecards. Earlier local voting under certified preparation is a pilot-and-measure agenda only — not a declaration that voting begins at 16. No invented civics-outcome statistics.

updates.title: Viewpoint-neutral civic service
updates.summary: Strengthens Constitutional Citizenship with public-trust safeguards: civic participation, not partisan participation. Schools may recognize civic participation regardless of viewpoint but may not require support for any candidate, party, or policy as a graduation condition. Adds Civic Service Portfolio pathways, optional safeguarded political participation, reflection without predetermined conclusions, Civic Achievement Transcript, and the principle that government should encourage participation, not ideology. No invented civic-credit statistics.

updates.title: Constitutional Family Doctrine and Human Flourishing Index
updates.summary: Major pillar: children are the republic's greatest long-term asset; family-first care ladder; dignity-safe shared responsibility (rejects 'productive' as a worth test); no child should go hungry with state as last-resort guarantor; Family Wealth System; child flourishing measurement. Also locks living-philosophy identity, Systems Map, Knowledge Graph scaffold, and Human Flourishing Index as defining benchmark (Did human life improve?) — architecture only; Phase 2 remains PARTIAL; modeling/legal 0%; no invented childhood or flourishing scores.

updates.title: Constitutional Capitalism Assistance Doctrine
updates.summary: Major pillar: reject one-size-fits-all assistance; guarantee security while dismantling dependency; six pathways (permanent protection, childhood, caregiving, temporary stabilization, working-but-insecure, capable-but-disconnected); eliminate benefit cliffs; Human Prosperity Account and Prosperity Navigators; Community Work Guarantee as alternative to UBI; employer responsibility; asset-building; fair reciprocity; fraud without humiliation; honest exit measurement; Prosperity and Participation Centers. SNAP FY2024 scale sourced (41.7M / 12.3%); phaseout rates not invented; Phase 2 remains PARTIAL; modeling/legal 0%.

updates.title: Forensic audit now governs Phase 2
updates.summary: Locks forensic audit as operating authority: architecture ahead of evidence; canonical Phase 2 acceptance checklist; Burt steps 1–13 only; steps 14–25 deferred; three-layer brief enforcement via phase2:validate; baseline narratives reconciled to 86 metrics (2/86 remains visible); Phase 2 stays PARTIAL until checklist passes. Modeling/legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Public statistics bridge architecture (RedDirt → CC)
updates.summary: Queues CC-PHASE-2-PUBLIC-STATISTICS-BRIDGE-1.0: RedDirt remains Census/BLS ingestion host; isolated public_statistics boundary; CC consumes validated secret-free snapshots only; no campaign/operational data; no API keys in Astro/GitHub; first-wave 10–15 metric candidates mapped as design; import stubs + imports:validate. Baseline remains 2/86 until real validated observations land. Subordinate to forensic audit / Phase 2.1.

updates.title: RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform (RCIP) vision
updates.summary: Formalizes RedDirt (H:\\SOSWebsite\\RedDirt) as the shared Public Data Engine for Constitutional Capitalism and future civic apps. CC must not duplicate Census/BLS connectors. Consumer contract is named validated measures plus full provenance. Campaign, public-statistics, and research data remain logically separated. Phase 2 still uses secret-free snapshots; baseline 2/86 unchanged by architecture.

updates.title: RCIP shared civic-data spine formalized
updates.summary: Formalizes RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform as the shared civic-data spine: ingest/normalize/verify once; multi-source validation; four layers (raw, canonical, evidence/confidence, product projection); isolated schemas; CC as first external proof consumer with rich statistic display contract (source, confidence, disagreement, applications). Architecture only — baseline 2/86 unchanged.

updates.title: RCIP Phase 1 spine consumer bridge (PARTIAL)
updates.summary: Registers CC-DEC-079 / RCIP-PHASE-1-PUBLIC-STATISTICS-SPINE-1.0 consumer side: publicstats:import|validate|report; RedDirt spine audited and scaffolded. Live Census/BLS ingestion blocked by unusable keys in RedDirt env — no observations imported; baseline remains 2/86; progress not inflated by infrastructure.

updates.title: Federalism Doctrine as major constitutional pillar
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-35 / CC-DEC-080: federal government limited, capable, transparent, and focused — not weak. Governing rule: power remains local unless national coordination, uniformity, or constitutional-rights protection is required. Framework, sixteen website branches, upward-transfer test, funding-without-domination, emergency sunsets, agency review. Architecture only; legal/modeling remain 0%. Confirms forensic-audit governance and Assistance Doctrine already preserved on main (4a2b1dc).

updates.title: Popular Sovereignty and the People’s Branch doctrine
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-36 / CC-DEC-081: Sovereign People as fourth branch and first source of authority; reserved initiative/referendum/veto/recall/amendment/audit powers; hard rights floor against majoritarian abuse; 18-year active SCOTUS terms and Judicial Accountability Council; rejects ordinary partisan Justice recall; anti-wealth ballot safeguards; Citizens’ Deliberative Assembly. Sourced structural baselines (Marbury, NCSL initiative/recall, 2023 Code of Conduct). Federal redesign requires amendment; legal/modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Citizen Public Service — responsibility, not privilege
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-37 / CC-DEC-082: public office is constitutional service, not a pathway to a privileged class. Eliminates office-tied special privileges while preserving benefits earned under the same rules as everyone else. Equal systems, citizen legislature, fair transparent compensation, cooling-off, disclosures, civic honor. Complements modernization public-service spine. Architecture only; no invented benefit statistics; legal/modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Citizen-Service Government — serve without sacrifice
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-38 / CC-DEC-083: expands Citizen Public Service into Citizen-Service Government so ordinary working people can serve without sacrificing livelihood, business, family, or retirement. Separates temporary democratic leadership from professional administration. Eighteen-reform agenda including Public Service Leave, Replacement Fund, Civic Enterprise Continuity, structured sessions, regional centers, nonpartisan staff, open pipelines, rotation without amnesia, return plans, and Citizen Public Service Commission. Operational principle: Serve without sacrifice. Govern without privilege. Return without penalty. Architecture only; no invented program costs; legal/modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Constitutional Defense and National Resilience
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-39 / CC-DEC-084: constitutionally defensive doctrine — neither hawkish nor pacifist. Armed Forces loyal only to the Constitution; deterrence measured by wars prevented; veterans as civic leaders with service-rendered healthcare obligations distinct from political privilege; voluntary plural national service; family readiness; transparent defense industries; community and National Resilience beyond force structure; constitutional limits on domestic/partisan military use. Architecture only; no invented force-structure or VA statistics; legal/modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Civic Wealth — investment through contribution
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-40 / CC-DEC-085: signature shift from benefit stacks to republic investment in a servant’s next chapter. Civic Wealth Ladder, Veteran Prosperity Pathway, compounding ownership opportunities, service multipliers, Civic Investment Accounts, rural revitalization, non-hereditary Legacy Multiplier, broader Constitutional Service pathways, and anti-patronage guardrails. Greatest wealth pathways for lasting community value creators — not extractors. Architecture only; no invented account balances; legal/modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Energy Sovereignty and the People’s Energy Dividend
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-41 / CC-DEC-086: major energy doctrine — serve people first, strengthen nation second, export surplus third. Sovereignty not autarky; diversified engineering system; American Energy and Resilience Corporation; National Energy Prosperity Fund (illustrative allocations require modeling); debt-first then community prosperity; Community Energy Dividends; Domestic Prosperity Test; anti-raid guardrails; abundance with stewardship. Sourced EIA/DOE baselines (2024 net energy surplus; 2025 electricity, crude, LNG records). Architecture only; legal/fund modeling remain 0%.

updates.title: Health, Human Capacity, and Community Care
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-42 / CC-DEC-087: major healthcare doctrine as human-capital infrastructure — universal essential foundation following the person; shared Health and Human Capacity Contribution; Community Health Readiness Budgets; Rural Health Equity Formula; Primary and Preventive Care Floor; risk-adjusted outcomes; Community Health Network; rural workforce pipeline; State Health Prosperity Fund; Prevention Dividend; pharma and insurance reform. Sourced CMS/HRSA/CDC/ACHI baselines. Architecture only; financing formulas and legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Prosperous Aging System — protect Social Security, build ownership above it
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-43 / CC-DEC-088: Shared Prosperity Retirement with Social Security as permanent floor; Citizen Ownership Accounts; Community Prosperity Trusts; Retirement Essentials; Local Aging Networks; corporate contributions; 30-year transition; Retirement Security Covenant. Sourced SSA/GAO/IRS baselines. Architecture only; financing formulas and legal remain 0%.

updates.title: Local Food and Family Farm Prosperity System
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-44 / CC-DEC-089: family farms as community wealth engines — Local Food Prosperity Funds, institutional purchasing guarantees, Food Utility Cooperatives, stewardship contracts, regenerative transition guarantees, next-generation ownership, Farm Service Corps, community food accounts, farm retirement security, anti-concentration protections, and Local Food Prosperity Scorecards. Sourced USDA ERS/FNS baselines. Complements Community Food Security. Architecture only; purchase floors and financing require modeling; legal 0%.

updates.title: Community Prosperity Accounts
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-45 / CC-DEC-090: Community Prosperity Accounts — dual retirement with optional local productive investment, Community Investment Units, Community Equity Credits, cities as thirty-year wealth builders, Community Wealth metrics, and fiduciary safeguards. Elaborates Prosperous Aging Layer 3; links Civic Wealth and foundational communities. Sourced ICI/MSRB/GAO baselines. Architecture only; allocation caps require modeling; legal 0%.

updates.title: Community Resilience System
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-46 / CC-DEC-091: emergency services as prosperity infrastructure — integrated Community Resilience System, prevention-first budgeting, Community Safety Dividend, volunteer prosperity pathways, Emergency Reserves, healthcare continuum, insurance partnership, service recognition, and Resilience Scorecard. Sourced ISO PPC and NFPA volunteer baselines. Architecture only; dividend/reserve formulas require modeling; legal 0%.

updates.title: Local Ownership Prosperity Framework
updates.summary: Adopts CC-PRIN-47 / CC-DEC-092: reward measurable local prosperity contributions of family, employee, cooperative, and locally controlled enterprises — classification, Local Prosperity Score, patient capital, succession, procurement weighting, Cooperative Development Centers, Community Prosperity Account link. Does not punish large businesses or ban outside investment. Sourced NCEO ESOP and USDA ag-coop baselines. Architecture only; score weights require modeling; legal 0%.

updates.title: Doctrine Freeze and Architecture Incubator
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-093: no new principles unless they close a Phase 2 proof gap; Hypothesis Cards + Proof Packets; three-layer historical/economic/legal reviews required before doctrine graduation; recent surge (Family Farms, Community Prosperity, Resilience, Local Ownership) reclassified as Architecture Candidates / not publishable. Priority returns to Burt proof steps.

updates.title: Proof Burden Standard (CC-PRIN-44 exemplar)
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-094: explicit Proof Burden tables separate architectural completion from evidentiary completion. Seeds CC-PRIN-44 with nine proof categories (historical/economic/pilots Partial; constitutional/fiscal/impact/environmental/admin Open) and five scaffold evidence packets. Phase 2 remains PARTIAL; publishable=false; advance proof before architecture.

updates.title: Ten Foundational Axioms
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-095: proposed distillation of First Principle + ten axioms. Interprets Foundational Philosophy ~82% as integration/bounding gap, not missing domains. No new principle ID; Declaration not rewritten. Traceability rule: doctrines must derive from axioms or be questioned.

updates.title: Collaborative Constitutional Review (deferred capstone)
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-096: last major feature captured as Phase 9 Collaborative Constitutional Review — scholarly margin review, anonymous-but-accountable contributors, review-artifact lifecycles, version awareness. Not crowdsourcing. Not built now. Activation only after proof, legal, modeling, manuscript, and education maturity plus platform protection.

updates.title: Systems Intelligence Engine (true capstone)
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-097: Phase 8 = Collaborative Review; Phase 9 = Constitutional Capitalism Systems Intelligence Engine (RedDirt-connected whole-system impact, simulation, learning, red-team, AI governance). AI analyzes; humans decide. Architecture only — not built; modeling progress not inflated.

updates.title: Peer-review journal model and Impact Requests
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-098: Collaborative Review refined as academic peer-review (expertise domains + typed reviews), not a comment platform; Impact Requests bridge Phase 8→9 System Impact Reviews; five-stage progression Discover→Prove→Write→Review→Understand locked. Architecture only.

updates.title: Three eras roadmap stable; explainability; Policy Diff
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-099: Era I Creation / Era II Review (Phase 8) / Era III Intelligence (Phase 9) locked as stable. Captures Principle of Explainable Systems Intelligence (engine rule, not CC-PRIN-*) and Policy Diff Analysis (HYP-120). Freezes further Phase 8/9 architecture expansion. Return to Burt Step 2 proof.

updates.title: Constitutional process and constitutional symmetry
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-100: five-stage framework process with separated authorities; Constitutional Symmetry architectural doctrine (not CC-PRIN-*); knowledge-graph primacy for Phase 9; affirms architecture freeze and return to Phase 2 scholarship (PP-FF-01 / Burt Step 2).

updates.title: Architectural freeze — invention to stewardship
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-101: CC-DEC-100 is the freeze point. Architecture transitions from invention to stewardship. Future architectural changes require a high-threshold gate. Mindset shifts to 'Can we prove what we already have?' Return to Burt Step 2 and proof packets.

updates.title: Proof Packet Falsifiability Standard
updates.summary: Adopts CC-DEC-102: research-program mode. Every proof packet must be capable of disproving the doctrine it examines. Evidence-driven revision is governance success. PP-FF-01 is the methodology template. Burt Step 2 is the operating rhythm. No new architecture.

updates.title: Investigator philosophy under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision)
updates.summary: Records guiding philosophy for proof packets: discover the truth about the architecture — do not defend it. Investigators not advocates. Supports/Qualifies/Contradicts with no protect-the-doctrine outcome. Constitutional case-law mental model. Phase 2’s real deliverable is trust. Next achievement: complete PP-FF-01 as methodology demonstration.

updates.title: Five scholarship questions; PP-FF-01 as methodology validation
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision): every proof packet must answer five scholarship questions; PP-FF-01 validates the research methodology itself; healthy Supports/Qualifies/Contradicts mix is success; Phase 2 legacy is the method. Architectural chapter remains closed.

updates.title: Architecture chapter closing note (under CC-DEC-102)
updates.summary: Closing note, not a new decision: credibility rests less on originality of ideas than on transparency of how ideas survive scrutiny. Inspect the process, not trust the authors. PP-FF-01 success establishes testability, reproducibility, and governance function. Next milestone is execution. Architectural chapter closed.

updates.title: Architecture Chapter formally complete — Research Chapter opens
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision): Architecture Chapter formally complete. Historian closing paragraph recorded. Research Era metrics defined (packets, claims, confidence, contradictions, qualifications, reproducibility, transparency). Identity (stable) vs hypotheses (testable) distinguished. Progress = hypotheses honestly tested. Next: PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Reviewer's Charter for first collaborators (deferred)
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102/096 (not a new decision; not Phase 8 activation): captures Reviewer's Charter — invite scrutiny for intellectual seriousness, not advocacy. Expected economist-style challenge questions recorded. Success = serious scholarship engaged on merits. Use after proof progress; PP-FF-01 remains next execution milestone.

updates.title: Disciplinary reviewer profiles; Founding Steward beta
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-096/098/102 (not a new decision; not Phase 8): reviewers register by primary expertise, professional background, and optional analytical frameworks — not political identity. Multi-perspective review and deferred coverage dashboards noted. Founding Steward (Steve) formalized as BETA end-to-end governance user with role-simulation passes. Culture: help us make this stronger.

updates.title: Domain Stewards and independent review ecosystem
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-096/098/102 (not a new decision; not Phase 8): panels stress-test from complementary domains, not consensus. Domain Stewards answer whether a domain was treated fairly/rigorously/accurately. Independence preserved (review, not support). Review ecosystem roles: Domain Steward, Contributing, Methodology, Implementation, Cross-Domain. Ideal endorsement: disagree with conclusions but affirm honest treatment of the field.

updates.title: Meta-governance planning complete
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision): UPD-054–060 treated as one coherent governance philosophy. Meta-governance design complete. Separates empirical truth, normative judgment, and design judgment. Review culture = independent scholarly community (not advisory board). Remaining challenge is scholarly execution beginning with PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Living Community Laboratories; Lewisville case study (not pilot)
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision): adds Living Community Laboratories research category — integrated multi-doctrine community case studies, distinct from single-doctrine proof packets and from pilots. Lewisville captured as first Comprehensive Community Case Study scaffold (CC-CASE-LEWISVILLE-001 / HYP-121). Purpose: learn from the community. Six-part case structure. Does not displace PP-FF-01; no invented local statistics.

updates.title: Rose Bud Rural Education and Farm Community Laboratory
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not a new decision): captures Rose Bud as second Living Community Laboratory (CC-CASE-ROSEBUD-001 / HYP-122) — rural education/agriculture/trades hub hypothesis complementary to Lewisville. Architecture scaffold only; not a pilot; funding and LEARNS authority unproven. First research gate = marginal enrollment economics. Does not interrupt PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Rural Prosperity Campus Model (major research hypothesis)
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine / not a new principle): captures Rural Prosperity Campus as Living Community Laboratory research stream (HYP-123) — education as coordinating institution for regional food economy/workforce/farm prosperity. Nine ecosystem layers for study. Defining questions: education as productive economic infrastructure; school as economic coordinator without compromising educational mission. Related HYP-124 Distributed Arkansas Prosperity Network. Linked to Rose Bud case. Does not interrupt PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Comparative Living Community Laboratory methodology
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): Lewisville and Rose Bud framed as the start of comparative methodology across development engines (resource vs education/human capital). Guiding question: authentic prosperity engine per community—not one prescribed model. Future SIE synthesis compares conditions of success across community types. Closes the UPD-064 loop. Does not interrupt PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Evidence hierarchy; LCL conceptual planning closed
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): records four-level evidence hierarchy — Proof Packets → Living Community Laboratories (field sites, not demos) → Comparative Community Research → Systems Intelligence. Protects against overgeneralizing from one success. LCL conceptual planning complete (UPD-061–065). Execution resumes with PP-FF-01.

updates.title: Proof Packet Operating System 1.0
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): ships CC-PHASE-2.1 Proof Packet OS — canonical template, JSON contract, verdict/confidence standards, lifecycle, validation checklist, methodology audit, registry, and npm run proofpacket:validate. Root: research/proof_packets/. No new principles. No architecture changes.

updates.title: PP-FF-01 executive draft — Qualifies
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): first executive Proof Packet PP-FF-01 (Local Food and Family Farm Prosperity) executed on OS 1.0. Verdict Qualifies; overall confidence Low. Registered USDA baselines support narrow predicates; full HYP-116 comparative prosperity claim unproven. Contrary external literature logged as gap. Doctrine and architecture unchanged. Methodology lessons recorded before PP-02.

updates.title: Methodology calibration 1.0 — CONDITIONAL GO PP-02
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): PP-FF-01 used to calibrate the research methodology. Lessons, confirmation-bias audit, friction/reproducibility reviews, verdict decision tree, quality metrics, version history, and improvement backlog shipped. Methodology 1.1 proposed. PP-02 readiness: CONDITIONAL GO.

updates.title: Canonical Research Corpus foundation
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): research/corpus/ established as reusable evidence library (sources, topics, evidence objects, authors, institutions, contradictory registry, citation/quality standards). Seeded from PP-FF-01 USDA sources. npm run corpus:validate.

updates.title: Living Community Laboratory Operating System
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): LCL OS templates, contracts, prosperity engines, comparative methodology, systems-map/scenario/metrics frameworks. No Lewisville/Rose Bud field implementation.

updates.title: Research Intelligence Pipeline framework
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): review-first 10-stage research supply chain framework. AI may organize; humans verify. No live scraping; no automatic doctrine influence.

updates.title: Continuous Research Watch framework
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): watch registry, alert queue, confidence-drift framework, timeline. PP-FF-01 and claim watches seeded. Recommends only; never auto-updates verdicts.

updates.title: Knowledge Graph Foundation seed
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): node/relationship contracts, type registries, seed graph for PP-FF-01/HYP-116/CLAIM-124, graph:build and graph:validate. Not Systems Intelligence.

updates.title: Evidence Synthesis Engine framework
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): synthesis contract, evidence matrix, conflict matrix, gap registry, topic confidence. Informs researchers; never auto-changes doctrine.

updates.title: Scenario & Modeling Laboratory framework
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): model contracts, variable/assumption/constraint registries, sensitivity and uncertainty standards. No executed models; modeling honesty dial remains 0%.

updates.title: Digital Observatory framework
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-102 (not doctrine): measurement contract, domain/index/baseline registries, quality framework. Observes structure only — no fabricated measurements or projections.

updates.title: Arkansas local-news outlet map & coverage matrix pilot
updates.summary: Under CC-DEC-103 (not doctrine): completed outlet inventory + Civic Information Coverage Matrix pilot for Searcy, Lafayette, West Helena/Phillips, Jacksonville, Benton, and Pulaski. All six show nominal/regional outlets; nearly all Institution×variable cells remain not_yet_coded — directional evidence that outlet presence ≠ sustained institutional scrutiny. No composite scores. No financing proposal. Sources CC-SRC-149–163.
